answers.q1: uv (uv.lock, .python-version=3.11). Install with: uv sync --group dev --extra all. CI test jobs use: uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all
answers.q2: uv run bash scripts/run-tests.sh (this runs: PYTHONPATH=./docs_src pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/). CI runs it with coverage as: uv run --no-sync bash scripts/test-cov.sh
answers.q4: CI's lint/format job runs pre-commit hooks through prek: uv sync --locked --extra all && uv run prek run --all-files (CI itself uses --from-ref origin/<base> --to-ref HEAD --show-diff-on-failure). The hooks include ruff check, ruff format, mypy fastapi, ty check, typos and zizmor. To run the checks directly without hooks, use: uv run bash scripts/check-style.sh (mypy fastapi; ty check; ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts; ruff format fastapi tests --check)
answers.q5: Don't edit by hand: uv.lock (use uv lock or uv add instead); README.md (generated from docs/en/docs/index.md by 'uv run ./scripts/docs.py generate-readme'); docs/en/overrides/partials/banner-sponsors.html (rendered from docs/en/data/sponsors.yml by 'scripts/docs.py render-banner-sponsors'); the Languages section of docs/en/mkdocs.yml (rewritten by 'scripts/docs.py update-languages'); translated docs under docs/<lang>/ for every lang except en (e.g. docs/de/), which are LLM-generated and fixed by scripts/translate.py and scripts/translation_fixer.py. A hook also checks that these are not edited by hand. No vendored directories found.
